app.name: NaWeAgree
app.tagline: Make una both remember the same thing
app.meta.description: Write am down. Make una two see am. Make una agree — before money change hand. For tailors, mechanics, artisans, and anybody wey don taya for ‘I thought you say…’
cta.agreeVersion: I see am, I agree with {version}
status.invited: De wait make dem open the link
status.ready_for_review: De wait for dem to review am
status.stalled: Nobody reply for one week — nudge dem?
error.generic: Something spoil — we don write am. Try again.
error.offline: You no dey online. Your last action don save, e go send when you come back.
error.conflict: Another person post new version while you dey type. We don load the latest — look am well and try again.
error.state: This plan no ready for that one yet.
receipt.title: Your signed record
receipt.subtitle: Save this file somewhere safe. Any of una fit upload am back later to prove wetin una agree.
receipt.notContract: This na shared record, e no be contract.
receipt.verify.ok: Signature match — this na real NaWeAgree record.
receipt.verify.bad: This no look like one of our receipts (signature no match).
receipt.verify.dev: Signature match, but dem sign am with dev key — no be production record.
privacy.title: Your data, your call
privacy.subtitle: NDPR give you right over your data. You no need email anybody — use the buttons down.
privacy.export: Export everything NaWeAgree get about you (plans wey you start or join) as JSON file.
privacy.delete: Delete everything wey tie to this device. Dem go remove your name from plans; you no fit undo am.
privacy.pending: We dey work on your request — e go ready soon.
privacy.ready: Your export don ready to download.
abuse.title: Report something wey no right
abuse.subtitle: If person dey use NaWeAgree to harass, scam, or impersonate, tell us. Human go read every report.
abuse.reason.impersonation: E dey pose like another person
offline.title: You no dey online
offline.subtitle: You still fit read plans wey you open before. New messages go send when you come back online.
principles.title: Our four promises
principles.1.title: Silence no be agreement
principles.1.body: Nothing no count until person actively tap ‘I don see am and I agree.’ No pre-ticked box.
principles.2.title: Changes na new version
principles.2.body: Edited plans no overwrite the old ones. Everybody go re-review the new version.
principles.3.title: Your words, no be our own
principles.3.body: No AI dey fill terms for you. You go write wetin una agree, with your own mouth.
principles.4.title: Any of una fit waka comot
principles.4.body: Withdraw na one tap. Plan no be cage — e be shared memory.
footer.tagline: Built for markets, workshops, and honest work across Nigeria.
footer.rights: © {year} NaWeAgree. We make am for Lagos.
legal.notContract: This na shared record, e no be contract.
